digest.component_or_area: Ruff lint configuration and RUF rule enforcement
propositions: Enable RUF rule family in tool.ruff.lint.select and establish a ratchet to prevent regression of RUF diagnostics.
Defer RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003 in tool.ruff.lint.ignore to preserve intentional Unicode in prose and UI content.
Remediate 179 actionable RUF diagnostics (RUF059, RUF022, RUF012, RUF005, RUF043, RUF023, and others) via safe mechanical fixes and manual review.
Assert that tool.ruff.lint contains no extend-ignore key and no RUF-prefixed codes in per-file-ignores configuration.
Verify that ruff check with full configured rule set exits cleanly and removes only stale RUF100 suppressions that are genuinely unused under the final configuration.
